name: Basketball
description: Basketball word search puzzles gather court English — dribble, backboard, assist, bench, rebound and free throw vocabulary — without team or shoe brands. Free online for adults and seniors; easy through hard plus large print. Parent theme: Sports. No timer and no account. Pair with Soccer, Baseball or Tennis for more sports hubs. Use large print when you want bigger letters, and see how to play if you are new to Words at Rest.
